title: Verify qualified layout A adapter
preconditions: TALLY_INGEST_PRIVATE_FIXTURE_MANIFEST names at least one ignored Layout A candidate and its external expected facts; PdfPig extraction is available. A candidate is qualified only when every transaction-bearing row exposes complete deterministic description evidence.
steps: Load every Layout A candidate through PrivateStatementFixtureSet; extract PdfDocumentEvidence twice; run PdfTextLayoutAStatementAdapter probe. For each exact match, compare ordered records, exact facts, exclusions, controls, and deterministic safe digests. For each candidate lacking unique required row evidence, assert no_match and no ExtractedStatement. Run layout B and drifted evidence as negative probes.
expected: Exactly pdf-text-layout-a-v1 matches each qualified Layout A fixture and every private expected fact/control agrees twice. A Layout A candidate with missing or ambiguous required description evidence no-matches without producing a statement or Ledger mutation. The current authorized fixture remains blocking evidence under OQ-INGEST-18 until its source/provenance or v1 support decision changes.
cleanup: Dispose immutable evidence and isolated test state; leave caller-owned fixture bytes unchanged.
